description: Bounty: The Pirate Frigate: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: A pirate frigate known as the {target} has been robbing {client} ships in {system} for a season. {client} has a bounty on it. The {target} usually has fighters for company and a habit of calling for more. Kill it.
{target} is a pirate frigate. {client} wants it dead and will pay well. Expect escorts and a reserve.
Bounty on the {target}. A pirate frigate and a bad reputation. {client} pays on confirmation.
success: The {target} is gone. {client} pays {captain} the bounty and puts the frigate's name on a list of things that have ended.
Bounty claimed. {client} pays and the lane begins to fill with freighters again.
The {target} burns. {client} pays and quietly wonders who the pirates' next captain will be.
failure: The {target} gets away. {client} cancels the bounty and keeps the story.
You are beaten off. The pirate frigate remains and so does the bounty.
radio-escort: There is the {target}. Four escorts, all aware of you.
Frigate found. It is not hiding. It is waiting.
Target in sight. Go for the frigate.
radio-friends: More hulls. The {target} called for help.
They have friends. Do not stop.
radio-flee: The pirate gunships are running for a gate. Finish them.
Two stragglers. Do not let them tell the others.
Gunships leaving. They will warn the next band.
